name: rka
description: Research Knowledge Agent (RKA) integration for Claude Code. Connects Claude to a local RKA backend for provenance-tracked research workflows: journal entries, decisions, literature, missions, claims, evidence clusters, and a research graph shared across the three-actor model (Brain in Claude Desktop, Executor in Claude Code, PI human researcher). The agentic-branch distribution ALSO ships the LangGraph orchestrator surface (rka-orchestrator MCP + orchestrator-pi skill + /orchestrator-start, /orchestrator-inbox, /orchestrator-status slash commands) for driving Brain⇄Executor⇄PI workflows directly from Claude Code. Activates on RKA, research notes, knowledge graph, decisions, missions, journal entries, evidence clusters, literature, organizing research, tracking provenance, knowledge base, orchestrator, LangGraph, ratification, PI inbox.
